# Policymaker #275, iteration 0041

## What changed and why
- Iteration 0040 results: landing #272 finished and merged at 88eb9a9. I checked main and found the split files at their reviewed hashes (`split_boundary.py` 1365e531…). The evaluator exits 0 with errors [] and missing [] and counts 55 references. I deleted `execution/scripts/land_split_269.py` because its work is done.
- Review #273 accepted the split boundary design with no blocking findings. Two findings are non-blocking: at `split_boundary.py:126` and `:130`, two self-mutations are rejected before they reach the rule they are meant to test. All 5 probes were rejected as expected. The author was copilot and the reviewer was codex. Both are GPT-family models, and the pin records this limit.
- I wrote `execution/scripts/pin_split_273.py`, a hash-gated, idempotent script that pins the reviewed design:
  - It sets the split milestone to `design-reviewed`.
  - It replaces the outdated "Split remains not-started…" limitation sentence with a design-only description: no allocation, no executed isolation, store #268 not ready, no secrecy claimed.
  - It adds the 4 design files to the split milestone and re-pins the references to the status file.
- I ran the script twice on a clone of main without LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. The output was the same both times: status sha fae1e26d…, preparation.json 98077172…, 59 evidence references, `score.py --check` exit 0, and no files outside the two preparation JSON files.
- Order `pin-split-273` (benchmark, low effort, 20 min/25 turns, from main, at most 6 tool calls). Expected gain: the last `not-started` milestone becomes `design-reviewed`. The next session checks it by reading the status sha, the 59 references and the split label on main.
- I did not order the checker fix in parallel because it changes `split_boundary.py`, which the pin script hash-checks.
- This is still not benchmark readiness: there is no allocation or executed isolation and no native evidence, and challenge and agent runs have not been executed. Owner acceptance of the method has not been requested.

## What next
- Saved work: the pin script (dry-run verified) and working memory section "Iteration 0041".
- Next step: verify the pin on main and delete `pin_split_273.py`. Then order one small mutation fix for review findings 1–2 and re-pin `split_boundary.py`.
- After that, consider an independent review of the milestones still `prepared-not-reviewed` (coverage, sources, tasks), and prepare the owner presentation of `docs/research/0002-delivery.md`.
- Do not repeat: the #273 probes, or waiting on capabilities #169/#268.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
